native_drop: Original basis assignment and ordering; input uses native premerge snapshot projected without averaging; decoder original layer_prune with identity merge.
fps: Original FPS in incoming dtype, same per-image case seed; unique96/32 required, fail on degeneracy.
state_dump: Save pre-prune layer16 states and norms for all compressed arms; content-hash deduplicated. No answer labels used for selection.
limits: Interventions change downstream states; does not isolate additive causal contribution of basis or merging. Calibration/replay first; no superiority claims from point estimates.
